market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Bank strength provides a floor, but housing credit deterioration, a possible fourth RBA hike, and Persian Gulf oil volatility cap upside. Expect 3–5% downside risk into Q4 if rate expectations reprice.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Productivity 'bad to worse' and fiscal debt war constrain growth. Mining pipeline (iron ore, rare earths, gas) offers structural support. Housing correction of 10% would pressure financials and REITs. AI/tech sentiment provides a global tailwind but limited ASX direct exposure.
